description: Configure your team list embeds and displayed roles here

content.name: channelID
content.description: Channel-ID to run all operations in it

content.name: roles
content.description: Roles that should be listed in the embed

content.name: descriptions
content.description: Optional description of a listed role (Field 1: Role-ID, Field 2: Description)

content.name: nameOverwrites
content.description: optional; Allows to overwrite the displayed name of roles (Field 1: Role-ID, Field 2: Displayed Name)

content.name: includeStatus
content.description: If enabled, the current online status will be displayed in the staffmember-list

content.name: onlineShowHighestRole
content.humanName: Only list the highest role of a user?
content.description: If enabled, a staff member will only be listed under their highest role in the list.
